dataset_metadata.title: Comprehensive Indian Mining, Mineral Resources & MCX Commodities Knowledge Dataset
dataset_metadata.scope: Pan-India Mining Mines, Production, Pricing Dynamics, Global Benchmarks, Regulations

COAL_INDIA.pricing_mechanism: Fuel Supply Agreement (FSA) notification prices + E-Auction market premiums (+35% to +85% over FSA)
COAL_INDIA.key_cost_drivers: Heavy earthmoving machinery diesel, contractual overburden removal, wage revision provisions

NMDC.pricing_dynamics: Monthly domestic lump and fines price revision aligned with international Platts 62% Fe index and domestic steel mill demand
NMDC.royalty_and_cess: 15% royalty to state governments + 30% DMF (District Mineral Foundation) + NMET (2%)
NMDC.slurry_pipeline_infrastructure: Jagdalpur to Visakhapatnam slurry transport reducing logistics friction

TATA_STEEL.margin_sensitivity: Every $10/ton change in hard coking coal impacts EBITDA margin by ~180 bps

diversified_portfolio.aluminium: Vedanta Aluminium (Jharsuguda smelter 1.8 MTPA, Lanjigarh refinery 5 MTPA)
diversified_portfolio.oil_and_gas: Cairn Oil & Gas (Mangala, Bhagyam, Aishwarya in Barmer, Rajasthan)

VEDANTA.cost_structure: Aluminium cash cost targeting sub-$1,750/ton via captive coal blocks (Jamkhani, Radhikapur) and Lanjigarh alumina expansion

integrated_operations.upstream_india: Bauxite mining in Odisha, Utkal alumina refinery (2.5 MTPA), Hirakud, Mahan, Aditya smelters
integrated_operations.downstream_global: Novelis Inc - World leader in beverage can sheet recycling (61% recycled content) and automotive aluminium sheet

HINDALCO.cost_advantage: Utkal Alumina places Hindalco in the first quartile of the global aluminium cash cost curve
HINDALCO.copper_business: Birla Copper Dahej - One of the world's largest single-location custom copper smelters

HINDUSTAN_ZINC.global_standing: World's 2nd largest integrated zinc producer, 3rd largest silver producer globally
flagship_underground_mines: Rampura Agucha Mine (World's largest zinc-lead underground mine)
Sindesar Khurd Mine (World-class high silver grade ore body)
Zawar Mines (Heritage zinc-lead operation dating back to antiquity)
HINDUSTAN_ZINC.reserve_life: 25+ years of mine life backed by high-grade reserves
HINDUSTAN_ZINC.cost_of_production: Global 1st decile zinc cost producer (~$1,100/MT ex-royalty)

captive_assets.bauxite_mine: Panchpatmali Hills (Koraput, Odisha) - Exceptionally low mining cost
captive_assets.smelter_and_captive_power: Angul (460,000 MTPA aluminium smelter + 1200 MW CPP)

MOIL.market_share: India's largest manganese ore producer (~50% market share)
MOIL.critical_use: Essential deoxidizer and alloying element in steel manufacturing (6-8 kg Mn per ton of steel)

HINDUSTAN_COPPER.strategic_value: India's only vertically integrated copper mining company with primary mining leases

GOLD.domestic_pricing_formula: ((LME Gold USD/oz / 31.1035) * USDINR exchange rate * (1 + Import Duty + AIDC) * 10 grams) + Local Premium/Discount
GOLD.import_duty_structure: Basic Customs Duty + Agriculture Infrastructure & Development Cess (AIDC)

SILVER.industrial_applications_share: 60% of total demand (Solar Photovoltaic cells, 5G infrastructure, EV electrical contacts)

gold_silver_ratio_signals.above_85: Silver historically oversold relative to gold; high probability mean reversion long
gold_silver_ratio_signals.below_65: Silver relatively rich; caution on aggressive momentum

CRUDE_OIL.benchmark_linked: WTI Light Sweet Crude Oil (CME) mapped to INR
CRUDE_OIL.domestic_impact: India imports 85%+ of domestic crude consumption; every $10 rise widens CAD and pressures INR
CRUDE_OIL.inventory_reports_triggers: US EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report (Wednesdays 20:00 IST)

NATURAL_GAS.seasonal_drivers: US winter heating demand (Dec-Feb) and summer power cooling demand (July-Aug)
NATURAL_GAS.storage_report_triggers: EIA Natural Gas Storage Report (Thursdays 20:00 IST)

COPPER.global_benchmark: LME London Metal Exchange Grade A Copper
COPPER.economic_indicator: Dr. Copper - barometer of global industrial manufacturing, EV electrification and renewable energy buildout
